mapper.select: /* SlfChknOperPlcyMapper.countOverlengthIstrId */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO A WHERE A.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND A.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND A.CHKN_ISTR_NO IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(A.CHKN_ISTR_NO)) > 10
mapper.update: /* SlfChknOperPlcyMapper.upsert */ MERGE INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY A USING ( SELECT DISTINCT B.TMNL_SE_CD AS TMNL_ID, TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) AS SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, B.ALN_CD, B.PSG_TRNSP_YMD AS PLCY_YMD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO B WHERE B.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND B.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND B.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) IS NOT NULL ) B ON ( A.TMNL_ID = B.TMNL_ID AND A.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID = B.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID AND A.ALN_CD = B.ALN_CD AND A.PLCY_YMD = B.PLCY_YMD ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.LAST_MDFR_ID = 'SYSTEM', A.LAST_MDFR_IP_ADDR = '1.1.1.1', A.LAST_MDFCN_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TMNL_ID, SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, ALN_CD, PLCY_YMD, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( B.TMNL_ID, B.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, B.ALN_CD, B.PLCY_YMD, 'SYSTEM', '1.1.1.1', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.delete: /* SlfChknOperPlcyMapper.deleteMissing */ DELETE FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY A WHERE A.PLCY_YMD = #{ymd} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_BDPS_ISSU_INFO B WHERE B.PSG_TRNSP_YMD = #{ymd} AND B.CHKN_SE_CD = 'SCI' AND B.TMNL_SE_CD IN ('P01', 'P03') AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) IS NOT NULL AND B.TMNL_SE_CD = A.TMNL_ID AND TRIM(B.CHKN_ISTR_NO) = A.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID AND B.ALN_CD = A.ALN_CD )
